info.title: API Connect Portal Admin API
info.description: API for the API Connect Portal Admin subsystem

get.summary: Shows a list of apis from a site.
get.description: Show a list of apis of the provided org and catalog.

200.description: Successful output of the list apis command

get.summary: Get a specific api from a developer portal.
get.description: Get a specific api from the developer portal of the provided org and catalog. The id or name:version of a specific api needs to be provided. e.g. './apic --mode portaladmin api:get --server **api** --catalog **catalog** --org **org** my-api:2.0.0'.

200.description: Successful output of the get api command

get.summary: Get a specific entire api document from a developer portal.
get.description: Get a specific entire api document from the developer portal of the provided org and catalog. The id or name:version of a specific api needs to be provided. e.g. 'id-of-api-called-example-3' or 'example:3.0.0'.

200.description: Successful output of the get-document api command

post.summary: Add an attachment for the given api.
post.description: Add an attachment for a api within the developer portal of the provided org and catalog. A api can hold 10 attachments. The id or name:version of a specific api needs to be provided. e.g. 'id-of-api-called-example-3' or 'example:3.0.0'.

200.description: Successful add of the api attachment

post.summary: Add a tag for the given api.
post.description: Add a tag for a api within the developer portal of the provided org and catalog. The id or name:version of a specific api needs to be provided. e.g. 'id-of-api-called-example-3' or 'example:3.0.0'.

200.description: Successful add of the api tag

put.summary: Set an icon image for the given api.
put.description: Set an icon image for a api within the developer portal of the provided org and catalog. The existing icon will be overwritten. The id or name:version of a specific api needs to be provided. e.g. 'id-of-api-called-example-3' or 'example:3.0.0'.

200.description: Successful set of the api icon

get.summary: Get the configuration object that the developer portal holds.
get.description: Get the configuration object that the developer portal holds that was sent by APIM.

200.description: Successful output of the get apic config command

get.summary: Shows a list of applications from a site.
get.description: Show a list of applications of the provided org and catalog.

200.description: Successful output of the list applications command

get.summary: Get a specific application from a developer portal.
get.description: Get a specific application from the developer portal of the provided org and catalog. The id of a specific application needs to be provided. e.g. './apic --mode portaladmin application:get --server **api** --catalog **catalog** --org **org** my-first-application '

200.description: Successful output of the get application command

get.summary: Shows a list of consumer orgs from a site.
get.description: Show a list of consumer orgs of the provided org and catalog.

200.description: Successful output of the list consumer orgs command

get.summary: Get a specific consumer org from a developer portal.
get.description: Get a specific consumer org from the developer portal of the provided org and catalog. The id of a specific consumer organization needs to be provided. e.g. './apic --mode portaladmin consumer-org:get --server **api** --catalog **catalog** --org **org** acme-org'

200.description: Successful output of the get consumer org command

post.summary: Export a tgz containing the site content
post.description: Export a tgz containing the site content. You can export specific entity types and specific ids or you can generate a tar containing all content. Depending on your site's content please be advised that an export all can take a long time to complete. If called via the toolkit CLI, it will automatically poll the response every 30 seconds up to 25 minutes.

get.summary: When ready, streams a content export artifact.
get.description: When ready, streams a content export artifact back to the related task id that is provided in the arguments.

200.description: The export artifact stream.

404.description: This task and its related artifact could not be found.

406.description: The task is not an export operation and therefore an artifact cannot be streamed.

425.description: The artifact related to this task is still being processed.

delete.summary: If running, cancels a content export task.
delete.description: If running, cancels the content export task and deletes any related artifacts that have been generated.

204.description: The task has been cancelled and it's artifacts deleted.

get.summary: Returns information about the status of this task.
get.description: Returns information related to the task id that is provided in the arguments.

200.description: Task is ready to be obtained

410.description: The task and its artifacts have expired.

post.summary: Create a task that imports an archive of site content.
post.description: Creates a task that imports an archive of site content. The status of this task can be tracked with the /content/TASK_ID/status route. Depending on your site's content please be advised that an import can take a long time to complete. If called via the toolkit CLI, it will automatically poll the response every 30 seconds up to 25 minutes.

201.description: Successful create of the import task

delete.summary: If running, cancels a content import task.
delete.description: If running, cancels the content import task and deletes any related artifacts that have been generated.

204.description: The task has been cancelled and it's artifacts deleted.

get.summary: Returns information about the status of this task.
get.description: Returns information related to the task id that is provided in the arguments.

200.description: Task is ready to be obtained

410.description: The task and its artifacts have expired.
